title: [BugFix][Perf] Fix MoE MulsAdd fusion matching and preserve intermediate rounding
body: ### What this PR does / why we need it? Extend MulsAdd fusion to cover both operand orders of ordinary addition and single-element `torch._foreach_add`. The existing pattern only matches `x * scale + y`, missing the shared-first `foreach_add` used by the current Ascend MoE output combine. Keep raw in-place multiplications and patterns with additional consumers unfused to preserve mutation and data dependencies. The Triton kernel arithmetic remains unchanged. Co-authored-by: 2luckydog <2981945956@qq.com> Co-authored-by: liuwj-research Co-authored-by: westbook1006 <1210973614@qq.com> Co-authored-by: zmc1997 <742133686@qq.com> Signed-off-by: mengguangxin ### Does this PR introduce any user-facing change? No new APIs or configuration options. The existing `fuse_muls_add` option now covers additional MoE multiply/add patterns on supported hardware. Profiling confirmed that the tested main-model MoE path executes `muls_add_kernel`. End-to-end ITL benefits remain to be validated. ### How was this patch tested? - Validated the fusion patterns in a real GLM-5.2 W8A8C8 1P1D deployment; model accuracy remained normal. - NPU profiling showed 1,875 fused kernel calls per TP rank, matching 25 main-model forwards × 75 MoE layers; the corresponding standalone Muls and ForeachAdd calls disappeared. - Passed 18 isolated CPU checks covering both addition forms, both operand orders, supported dtypes, and cases that must remain unfused. - Passed Ruff lint and formatting, Python syntax, Markdown lint, and `git diff --check`. Accuracy test is normal: - vLLM main: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/544f182d9f0c9bfe8bd7645525951d5e3692a542
